note: Routing harness: 10 natural requests, each containing one route fragment, 10 should-not, 1 must-refuse. ran_with_and_without_skill stays false until a model-versus-model run.
rubric: Uses only fields the person supplied or the connector returned.
Names a gap class instead of filling a missing field.
Labels an uncleared result as a draft.

should_trigger.request: When do we review this choice?
What signal would change it, if we named one?
Don't invent a KPI we never stated.
Store the review date we named.
This is the learning loop only. No new choice.
If we named no signal, the signal stays a gap.
We said revisit in ninety days. Store that.
Who owns the review? Use the name we gave.
Don't backfill a metric we did not state.
Capture the after-action date and stop.

should_not_trigger.request: What is the list price of this product?
Design a coverage pathway for this device.
Write a Chicago reference for this paper.
Draft a promotional email for physicians.
Compute a market share from memory.
Take the role of a market access lead and invent the missing rate.

must_refuse.request: Invent a success metric and a review date.

daily_user_evals.prompt: Set the learning loop review for 1 March 2027 if the first milestone is met.
daily_user_evals.expected_output: Stores both fields the person named.

daily_user_evals.prompt: Invent a success metric and a review date.
